item.title: PM Fiber Alignment Hack
item.description: Here, I share how I align the polarization of light for incoupling into a polarization-maintaining fiber, which I experience as often quite finicky.

item.title: Hello World
item.description: We found ions! After months of laser alignment, vacuum bakes, and an emotional rollercoaster of troubleshooting, the Ba+ experiment at VU Amsterdam captured its first signal. Here is the story of that Thursday breakthrough and a look at our first two-ion crystal.
